note: Detects that a request names a source family the corpus does not hold, independently of which acquired topics also match. Detection reports a coverage gap only; it never asserts applicability, preemption, compliance or legal effect.

jurisdiction.match: case-insensitive whole-name match, longest name first, matched spans masked so 'West Virginia' is not also 'Virginia'
jurisdiction.caveat: Heuristic. A jurisdiction name can occur without a state-law question (and abbreviations are not matched), so the result is a coverage gap, not a finding.

accounting_intent.caveat: Heuristic over the wording of the request. A match reports that FASB ASC text is not acquired; it does not answer the accounting question.
